_about: Approximate USD per 1M tokens, for the $ columns only. Update to your real rates. Matched by first substring hit; falls back to _default.
_cache_about: cache_write / cache_read are multipliers on that row's input rate. Anthropic bills a 5-minute cache write at 1.25x input and a cache read at 0.1x. OpenAI charges nothing extra to create a cache entry and bills cached input at 0.1x. Rows omitting either field inherit _default's.
_order_note: Matched by FIRST substring hit, so specific ids must precede generic ones — 'claude-opus-5' also contains 'opus'. Rates verified 2026-07-30 against the current model table; opus-5-5 added 2026-10-18 ($4/$20, cache read $0.20 = 0.05x); sonnet-5 / sonnet-5-5 at $2/$10 and haiku-5-5 at $0.10/$0.50 (prompts up to 100K) verified the same day.
